prerequisites.title: Harvest administrator login
prerequisites.detail: Registering an OAuth application requires being logged in as an Administrator on the Harvest account. The app is created in the Developers section of Harvest ID.

prerequisites.title: App settings decided
prerequisites.detail: Registration asks for a name, a Redirect URL, whether the app is Multi Account, and Products (Harvest, Forecast or both). Pick the minimal scope required.

steps.title: Draft Harvest app settings
steps.detail: Prepare the app name, Products choice (minimal), Multi Account setting, and the redirect URL copied from the Composio dashboard.
steps.done_when: Settings list is ready to paste into Harvest ID.

steps.title: Register the OAuth2 application
steps.detail: As a Harvest administrator, create the OAuth2 application in the Developers section of Harvest ID with the drafted settings.
steps.done_when: Harvest shows a client ID and client secret.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the Harvest auth config through Composio's API using your own client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: Auth config exists for the harvest toolkit.

steps.title: Test a connection with another account
steps.detail: Connect a Harvest account other than the developer's and check that the right accounts are authorized.
steps.done_when: Connected account works and scopes match what the user chose.

traps.title: Managed app shows Composio branding
traps.detail: With the managed app, users see "Composio wants to access your account", and quota is shared across all Composio users. Switch to your own app before launch.

traps.title: Redirect URL must match
traps.detail: A redirect_uri passed at authorization must start with the Redirect URL registered with the app.

traps.title: Short-lived tokens
traps.detail: Harvest access tokens expire after 18 hours, so plan for token renewal.

traps.title: Granted accounts depend on the user
traps.detail: For multi-account apps, granted scopes depend on what the user chose. Single-account apps get one account chosen by the user.

items.reason: Quote states that to build integrations other users can use, an OAuth2 Application must be registered; the no-review-step parenthetical is consistent with the quote's silence on review.

Quote says a full OAuth2 flow allows other people to use integrations, but says nothing about review; 'no review step mentioned' is an absence claim the quote neither confirms nor contradicts, so only the usage part is supported.
Quote mentions scope being required for the integration to work but does not explicitly advise choosing the minimal scope.
Quote states each user is granted a token expiring in 18 hours.
Quote says a single-account app lets the user choose the account and the app receives only one scope back.
Quote says multi-account apps can receive any combination of scopes depending on what the user chose to authorize.
Quotes say other users can use the integration after registering an OAuth2 Application, but do not address whether provider review is needed; the no-review conclusion is only implied by silence.
Quotes mention registering an OAuth2 application for other users, but do not establish the ordered sequence of admin login, Harvest ID registration, and Composio credential setup.
Quote states the application must be registered with Harvest and the user must be logged in as an Administrator to access the page.
Quotes support that a Harvest OAuth2 app is needed for other users, but nothing on the Composio app taking minutes, the 1-2 hour effort, or the absence of a review wait.
